precedence: This file supersedes only conflicting Replace Resource limitation/open-defect statements in the base GCH. All non-conflicting base GCH invariants remain binding.
reason: The 2026-09-23 Y5E2 incident proved that the pre-fix Admin Replace Resource path updated canonical LESSONS_KV/R2 state but could leave the student-facing prepared lesson in READ_MODELS_KV pointing at the old object key. A later L3T2M24 incident additionally proved that the consistency wrapper must never reinterpret CORS OPTIONS preflight as a completed replacement transaction.

rootCause.preFixBehaviour: Admin Replace Resource uploaded and hash-verified the new R2 object and updated the selected canonical LESSONS_KV resource, but successful completion did not require the current prepared lesson projection to be republished and verified.
rootCause.failureSignature: Canonical lesson contains the new replacement r2Key while the current prepared lesson scope lesson:<lessonId> still contains the previous resource objectKey.
rootCause.importantRule: Admin source success is not student-visible completion. Replace Resource must complete the canonical -> prepared projection chain before reporting success.

requiredSuccessChain: upload a unique replacement PDF to MATERIALS_R2
read back the uploaded bytes and verify SHA-256
guard and update only the selected canonical LESSONS_KV resource r2Key
read back canonical lesson and verify exactly the intended new object key
resolve the current prepared lesson scope lesson:<lessonId> from READ_MODELS_KV
replace exactly one matching prepared resource objectKey
publish a new prepared read-model version atomically with previous-version rollback pointer
read back the current prepared scope and verify old key count is zero and new key count is one
return success only after canonical and prepared verification both pass

transportBoundary.rule: The canonical-to-prepared consistency transaction applies only to an actual POST /api/v1/admin/resources/replace operation. OPTIONS CORS preflight and all other non-POST methods must preserve the base Admin resource handler's status/body/CORS semantics. OPTIONS may additionally carry the diagnostic x-fpt-replace-resource-preflight-guard header so production can prove the guard survived bundling.
transportBoundary.why: Browser preflight is transport negotiation, not a replacement success response; interpreting its {ok:true} body as a replacement result prevents the browser from sending the actual POST.
transportBoundary.browserFailureSignature: Admin Console displays Replacement failed: Failed to fetch while the live OPTIONS request returns a non-2xx response.

failureSemantics.preparedPublicationFailure: Fail the Admin operation; do not report success.
failureSemantics.canonicalRollback: Restore the canonical lesson resource to the previous object key when prepared projection publication fails and canonical rollback can be verified.
failureSemantics.preparedPointerRollback: Restore the previous prepared pointer when a partially published prepared change must be unwound.
failureSemantics.newR2Cleanup: Delete the newly uploaded replacement object only when rollback gates prove it is safe to do so.

preservationRules: Do not change student entitlements or release state during resource replacement.
Retain the previous R2 object on successful replacement.
Do not weaken protected Answer Pack controls.
Do not change normal-student or Trial session semantics.
Do not use resource replacement as a mechanism for lesson release or access repair.
Do not wrap OPTIONS preflight in replacement consistency processing.

permanentRequirements: Changes to worker/src/admin-resource-replace-consistency.js trigger the production Admin deploy workflow.
The wrapper receives node --check syntax validation before deployment.
Current source wiring must import ./admin-resource-replace-consistency.js from worker/src/index-admin-tools.js.
After deployment, the live Worker package must contain replace-resource-consistency-v1, replace-resource-preflight-pass-v1 and RESOURCE_REPLACE_PROJECTION_FAILED or the workflow fails.
Replace Resource OPTIONS preflight from the Admin Console origin must remain HTTP 200 with the expected Access-Control-Allow-* headers.
staticCiRequirements: The consistency wrapper is a watched path for push and pull_request.
CI verifies the Admin entrypoint imports the consistency wrapper and verifies the live-marker/failure-marker strings remain present.

CI executes tests/admin-resource-replace-consistency-verification.mjs and proves OPTIONS preflight preserves HTTP 200, CORS and {ok:true} while exposing the diagnostic guard header instead of being treated as a replacement result.

ownerBrowserVerification.meaning: The owner verified the repaired Replace Resource behaviour through the live student-facing experience after the production fix.

incidentCloseout.note: The final repair verification was idempotent: by the guarded run, the prepared scope already contained the new key and no old key; the run independently read back and proved the correct state. The owner subsequently verified the student-facing result and closed the incident.

preflightIncident20260923.title: Linear Sequences
preflightIncident20260923.rootCause: worker/src/admin-resource-replace-consistency.js applied replacement-success validation to every request whose pathname was /api/v1/admin/resources/replace, including OPTIONS. The base handler correctly returned {ok:true} for OPTIONS, but the wrapper then required lessonId/oldR2Key/newR2Key, returned HTTP 500 RESOURCE_REPLACE_INCOMPLETE_SUCCESS_RESPONSE, and the browser therefore aborted the actual POST and surfaced TypeError: Failed to fetch.
preflightIncident20260923.mutationAssessment: The failed browser attempt did not reach the replacement POST. Canonical LESSONS_KV and current prepared READ_MODELS_KV remained on the original homework object key. The read-only 2.2 MB multipart probe also proved the edge/route accepts a payload of this order of size when the request reaches the Worker, so the observed incident is not explained by the replacement PDF being around 2 MB.
preflightIncident20260923.fix: Apply consistency processing only when pathname is /api/v1/admin/resources/replace AND request.method is POST. Preserve base OPTIONS status/body/CORS semantics and attach the diagnostic preflight guard header so the marker remains live in the bundled Worker.

firstProductionDeployAttempt.failureStage: Verify composed Worker implementation is live
firstProductionDeployAttempt.failureCause: The preflight guard marker constant was exported but not referenced by runtime code and was tree-shaken from the bundled Worker, so the live marker grep failed before the live preflight test ran.
firstProductionDeployAttempt.meaning: The deployment guard behaved correctly. The application fix was not left partially deployed; production returned to the known prior version.

markerLivenessHotfix.strategy: Reference the preflight guard marker in the actual OPTIONS response as x-fpt-replace-resource-preflight-guard while preserving the base response status, body and CORS semantics.
markerLivenessHotfix.testRequirement: The dedicated preflight regression test must assert the diagnostic header equals replace-resource-preflight-pass-v1.

closureGate: static CI PASS including the dedicated OPTIONS regression test and diagnostic header assertion
guarded shared Worker production deployment PASS with rollback anchor
live OPTIONS preflight from https://futureperfecttuitions.github.io returns HTTP 200 with CORS allow-origin/allow-headers/allow-methods
owner retries L3T2M24 replacement and confirms the Admin operation succeeds
student-facing resource is verified to resolve to the intended replacement before final incident closeout

verified: production Admin wiring and regression suite
live Replace Resource consistency implementation marker
live Admin routes remain unauthorised without an Admin session

supersededBaseStatements: Any open defect asserting that successful Replace Resource cannot automatically publish and verify the prepared lesson projection
currentRequiredBehaviour: A future Admin Console Replace Resource operation is successful only when the intended canonical resource and the current student-facing prepared lesson both point to the verified replacement object. If the prepared projection cannot be published and read back correctly, the operation must fail rather than present a false success state. CORS OPTIONS preflight is transport negotiation and must preserve the base handler's successful status/body/CORS semantics; it must never be interpreted as a replacement success response.
futureVerificationMatrix: For any Replace Resource code change, run static CI and production deploy guard.
Verify OPTIONS /api/v1/admin/resources/replace from the Admin Console origin returns HTTP 200 with CORS before relying on browser POST behaviour.
Verify the live OPTIONS response exposes x-fpt-replace-resource-preflight-guard: replace-resource-preflight-pass-v1 so the runtime guard is directly observable.
For an actual replacement, verify the returned operation succeeded only after the wrapper completed prepared publication.
When incident-driven, verify representative live /api/v2 resource delivery/browser behaviour before closing the incident if credentials/test persona are available.
Never infer student-visible success solely from R2 presence, LESSONS_KV state, or the Admin Console success message.
